lines.trans: If you ever want to talk about something and feel weighed down with no one to tell, you may talk to me.

words.gloss: if you are having a hard time

lines.trans: My lips are sealed, and I really enjoy listening too.
This right here is the editing room—the place where you will pull the most all-nighters from now on.
There are no windows in here—does it not look just like solitary confinement?
Even if you shoot it like dog-food cake, you just have to edit it into fine glutinous rice cake.
Except that fine rice cake is only made by pouring your sweat, tears, blood, and lifespan into this room.
Even pushing yourselves that hard, is everyone physically okay?
Not okay at all—there is zero ventilation inside the editing room, so the air is terrible.
Because we go so long without sunlight, our whole team started group-buying vitamin D just to stay alive.
My seniors told me that editing is not something you finish, it is something you merely stop.
It must mean it is work with no single right answer and no end—those words really hit home.
If you ever want to talk about something and feel weighed down with no one to tell, you may talk to me.
